name: @ohos-tailscale/netcheck
description: STUN wire format core + netcheck probe engine scheduling (tailscale net/netcheck aligned): binding request/response codec, deterministic StunTransaction, clock-driven probe-plan state machine (initial/incremental plans, debounce, early-stop), report aggregation with PreferredDERP hysteresis. Wire/IO (UDP sockets, DNS, timers, HTTPS/ICMP/portmapper probes) is injected by the app bridge.
